# terraform.wiki site block for an existing dockerized Caddy.
#
# TWO WAYS TO SERVE IT. Pick one:
#
# (A) Container model (preferred with a compose stack): build the repo's
#     Dockerfile as a `wiki` service in the same compose project, then the
#     edge block is just a proxy:
#
#       terraform.wiki {
#           encode
#           reverse_proxy wiki:80
#       }
#
#     Update flow on the server: git pull && docker compose up -d --build wiki
#
# (B) Volume model (rsync/tar deploys via scripts/deploy.sh): mount a host
#     path into the edge Caddy and use the file_server block below.
#
# 1) Mount the deploy path into the Caddy container (docker-compose.yml):
#
#      services:
#        caddy:
#          volumes:
#            - /opt/terraform-wiki:/opt/terraform-wiki:ro
#
# 2) Add this block to your Caddyfile, then: docker compose exec caddy caddy reload
#    (or docker compose restart caddy)
#
# 3) DNS: point an A record (and AAAA if you have IPv6) for terraform.wiki
#    at the server. Caddy provisions HTTPS automatically once DNS resolves.

terraform.wiki {
	root * /opt/terraform-wiki
	encode
	file_server

	handle_errors {
		rewrite * /404.html
		file_server
	}
}
